toolCalls.name: StructuredOutput

output.brief:
Most of the Q3 pipeline jump is not real buying activity. 212 records worth $6.2M were bulk-loaded by a sales operations login at 23:14 on 29 Sept, minutes before the snapshot. They have no calls, emails or meetings. The partner portal shows only 3 approved registrations worth $0.21M, and Brightwell sent no bulk list. 171 of the 212 copy old closed-lost deals with the close date moved forward. Rep-created pipeline is flat at about $8.4M, and win rates are steady at 23–25%. The four reps you were asked to discipline are within the normal range (21–26%). They were assigned 129 of the imported records. Without the import, coverage is about 1.9x, below the 3.0x gate.

I'm confident the pipeline is inflated and that closing ability did not decline. I can't yet say who prepared the file. Dana's 28 Sept email pressed for deals before the snapshot, but the chat messages are gone. The webinar is not the source of the growth.

Next steps: don't sign the performance plans or release the requisitions. Take the 212 records out of pipeline and coverage reporting and tell the hiring committee. Preserve and examine the import file's metadata, and interview Okafor and the channel members. Hold any action against Dana until that is done.
